A space station orbits above the Earth. There is an astronaut in the space station.
In the space station, the acceleration of free fall is 7.5m/s2.
On Earth, the acceleration of free fall is 9.8m/s2.
Which row about the astronaut’s mass and weight in the space station is correct?
mass of astronaut weight of astronaut

options.text: same as on the Earth less than on the Earth
same as on the Earth greater than on the Earth
lower than on the Earth less than on the Earth

questions.questionText:
A student is asked to predict whether a solid floats in a liquid.
Which information does the student require?

options.text: the density of the liquid and the mass of the solid
the density of the solid and the density of the liquid
the density of the solid and the mass of the liquid
the mass of the solid and the mass of the liquid

questions.questionText:
A substance is heated. The substance changes state from a liquid to a gas.
When the gas is cooled, it first becomes a liquid and finally a solid.
What is the order of changes of state for this substance?

A glass bottle containing warm air is sealed with a screw cap and then cooled in cold water.
cap
cold water air
The contraction of the glass bottle can be ignored.
What remains the same during the cooling?

options.text: the air pressure inside the bottle
the energy of the air particles in the bottle
the force on the cap made by the air particles in the bottle
the volume of air in the bottle

questions.questionText:
A gas is stored in a container of constant volume.
The temperature of the gas is increased.
What happens to the particles of the gas?

options.text: The distance between the particles increases.
The mass of the particles increases.
The speed of the particles increases.

questions.questionText:
One end of a shiny metal rod is heated, and the other end quickly gets hot.
Which statement describes why the other end quickly gets hot?

options.text: Shiny surfaces are good emitters of infrared radiation.
Shiny surfaces are poor emitters of infrared radiation.

questions.questionText:
Vacuum flasks usually have silvered walls that help to keep the contents of the flask hot.
Why are the walls silvered?

options.text: to absorb thermal energy from the air around the flask
to increase the rate of convection inside the flask
to reduce energy loss to the surroundings by conduction
to reflect thermal radiation back into the flask

What is the type of wave and what is the name of the seismic wave?

A person stands 1.0m in front of a plane mirror. The mirror is moved away from the person at a
speed of 1.0m/s.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The image moves away from the person at a speed of 1.0m/s.
The image moves away from the person at a speed of 2.0m/s.
The image moves towards the person at a speed of 1.0m/s.
The image moves towards the person at a speed of 2.0m/s.

The diagram shows the formation of an image by a thin converging lens.
Which terms describe the image?

Valuable objects are often marked with a special ink. In visible light, the ink cannot be seen.
The ink can be seen when exposed to the right type of electromagnetic waves.
Which type of electromagnetic waves are used for this type of security marking?

A siren is emitting a sound. As time passes, the sound becomes louder and higher pitched.
What is happening to the amplitude and to the frequency of the emitted sound wave?
amplitude frequency

A student rubs a plastic rod with a cloth.
Electrons move from the cloth to the rod.
Which statement about the rod is correct?

options.text: It is negatively charged and is attracted by a negatively charged object.
It is negatively charged and is attracted by a positively charged object.
It is positively charged and is attracted by a negatively charged object.
It is positively charged and is attracted by a positively charged object.

questions.questionText: Which expression is used to calculate electrical resistance?

A 5.0 resistor is connected in series with a 10 resistor.
There is a constant current in the 5.0 resistor.
Which statement about the two resistors is correct?

options.text: The current is greater in the 5.0 resistor.
The current is greater in the 10 resistor.
The potential difference (p.d.) is greater across the 5.0 resistor.
The potential difference (p.d.) is greater across the 10 resistor.

questions.questionText: Which statement explains where the switch for an electric lamp is connected?

options.text: The switch is in either the live wire or in the neutral wire as both wires carry the current.
The switch is in the earth wire to prevent the fuse from blowing when the lamp is in use.
The switch is in the live wire so that the lamp is disconnected from the mains supply when the switch is off.
The switch is in the neutral wire to prevent current leakage when the lamp is switched off.

negatively charged electrons surrounding a positively charged nucleus
positively charged electrons surrounding an uncharged nucleus
